cases.notes: FIDE TEC Tie-Break Exercises V01-1 (tec.fide.com, 2024-04-16), Example 06: player #4 (David 2050, 3.5/5: +B12, half-bye, +W13, =W3, =B1). Opponent #12 (Nick, 2.0) has R2 pairing-bye + R3 forfeit win at face value (16.3.1) and two trailing VUR withdrawals as draws (16.3.2): contribution 0+1+1+0.5+0.5=3.0. Player #4's R2 half-bye (requested, followed by played rounds -> 16.2.3, VUR) contributes dummy own 3.5, cut preferentially per 16.5.1: BH-C1 = 15.0-3.5 = 11.5 as printed. TRACEABILITY FLAG: the exercise text shows an intermediate '2.5' (50%-of-rounds dummy from an older draft) and prints summands '3.5+2.5+3.5+3.0+1.5 = 11.5' whose arithmetic is inconsistent (sums to 14.0); under the 2024 article text the dummy is own 3.5 and both readings cut to the same printed 11.5. Only the printed total 11.5 is asserted. Opponent stubs: #12 reconstructed per the exercise text; #1/#3/#13 single-game stubs at printed scores (Alyx 3.5, Charline 3.5, Opal 1.5).
cases.source: FIDE TEC Tie-Break Exercises V01-1 (tec.fide.com, 2024-04-16), Example 06
